tips.text: Hit the daily cap, then do the Syndicate Alerts and turn in every medallion; both bypass the cap.
Cap fast with Sanctuary Onslaught, Elite Sanctuary Onslaught or The Circuit past stage 4; that usually maxes the day.
Level New Loka alongside Perrin; Red Veil is neutral, so skip Arbiters of Hexis and Steel Meridian.
Keep the Perrin Sigil on in every mission; 15% of all your Affinity turns into standing.
Hit the cap every day; it resets at midnight UTC and unused cap is lost.
Nobody complains about the grind; the pistol is mediocre, so treat it as Mastery.
